notes.title: Update 1.06
notes.content:
What, a PSYCRON update?? More likely then you'd think! Thanks to Lojemiru and Miepee, this update fixes the game's longstanding issues with older integrated GPUs/Steam Decks had where certain visual elements wouldn't show up (like the map or pause screen!).

Changelog:
- Replaced palette swapping system to fix issues with some graphics devices
- Fixed draw depth issues that made the pause map and other elements invisible on some graphics devices
- Added "alt bindings" so that a control stick and the d-pad can be bound to movement at the same time
- Added vibration preview when changing strength
- Fixed a typo
- ... and other misc. fixes

Again, thanks to Lojemiru and Miepee for their work on the update. You can check out their stuff here:
https://github.com/Lojemiru/
https://github.com/Miepee

notes.title: Update 1.05
notes.content:
PSYCRON v1.05 is here to stay and again, is a lot of small bugfixes and tweaks.


Bugfixes:

There are multiple PSYCRON on board Ceremos! Except there aren't, and two PSYCRON won't spawn in the same room now.
Made a cieling less softlockable
One sound previously unaffected by the volume mixer now is
Stopped a hissing noise from persisting between cutscenes



Per the norm, feel free to let me know on Discord if anything's broken. Cheers!

notes.title: Update 1.04
notes.content:
Surprise surprise, another small bugfixes patch.

As per usual, any and all thoughts are welcome on the Discord!

Bugfixes:

Fixed a wrongwarp during the escape
Fixed a softlock in the 3.5th area
Fixed a softlock in the 4th area
Other small miscellaneous bugfixes

notes.title: Update 1.02
notes.content:
1.02 is now out and is another small features/bugfixes patch.

Feel free to join the Discord to stay tuned on future updates/tell me if something's not working!

New Features:

On the SUIT screen you can now see the current area's item percentage along with the global item percentage
Cursor is now hidden


Bugfixes:

	 Updated controller detection code, dinput controllers should now work better when Steam Input is disabled
  If you use a playstation dinput controller, disabling Steam Input will enable Playstation button icons
	 "Go Outside" achievement is now possible to achieve
	 Fixed occasional crash when fighting Noemi
	 Fixed controller vibration still occuring when set to 0%
	 Fixed several small tiling errors

notes.title: Update 1.01
notes.content:
A small bugfix and QOL update. 

Feel free to join the Discord to stay tuned on future updates/tell me if something's not working!

QOL Updates

 Item collection percentage is now displayed on the pause screen next to the in game timer
 Descriptions on two keybinds improved
 Support for Steam screenshots implemented
 Added Intel UHD Integrated graphics compatibility mode (UHD compatibility in display options). May fix issues with certain integrated GPUs not displaying the pause screen.


Bugfixes

 Achievements work now!
 Fixed bug which prevented 100% completion if an item was not collected in the Biodome early
 Fixed softlock in Biodome
 ...and a few other misc fixes and tweaks.
